description: This script seeds a database with demo users, recipes, and favorites for a recipe management application. It creates database tables if they don't exist, adds predefined users and recipes, and establishes favorite relationships among them. The script is meant for local development/testing purposes and includes logic to prevent duplicate data on repeated runs.

methods.name: None _ensure_tables()
methods.description: Creates database tables if they don't already exist.

methods.name: User _get_or_create_user(db: Session, email: str, username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Fetches an existing user by email or username, or creates a new user with hashed password.

methods.name: Recipe _get_or_create_recipe( db: Session, author_id: int, title: str, description: str | None, ingredients: str | None, instructions: str | None, image_url: str | None, )
methods.description: Fetches an existing recipe by author and title, or creates a new recipe.

methods.name: Favorite _favorite_if_not_exists(db: Session, user_id: int, recipe_id: int)
methods.description: Creates a favorite record for a user and recipe if it does not already exist.

methods.name: None run_seed()
methods.description: Main function that seeds the database with sample users, recipes, and favorites, and outputs a summary.

ctags.name: _favorite_if_not_exists
ctags.pattern: /^def _favorite_if_not_exists(db: Session, user_id: int, recipe_id: int) -> Favorite:$/

ctags.name: _get_or_create_recipe
ctags.signature: ( db: Session, author_id: int, title: str, description: str | None, ingredients: str | None, instructions: str | None, image_url: str | None, )

ctags.name: _get_or_create_user
ctags.pattern: /^def _get_or_create_user(db: Session, email: str, username: str, password: str) -> User:$/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, email: str, username: str, password: str)
